interface.shortDescription: Finish Claude-recorded demos: voiceover, intro video, final cut
interface.longDescription: Takes the handoff zip from the Webapp Capture plugin in Claude and finishes the demo: one ElevenLabs voiceover clip per caption line, an intro video from a Replicate model or free stock B-roll, and an ffmpeg stitch with captions. Includes the Replicate video MCP (seven models) and a frame review script. Local desktop workflow; each user supplies their own provider keys and approves paid generations.
defaultPrompt: Read CHATGPT-INSTRUCTIONS.md in my handoff zip and finish the demo video.
Check the Replicate video connection without generating anything.
Find free B-roll for a 5 second intro about scheduling software.
